QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_60

question.text: Under SAS-1100 a RECOMMENDATION the Niwas SIA report actually made was:

answer.text: Swagruha should partner with a bank/financing firm to develop a SAVINGS SCHEME for beneficiaries to fund future repairs — so that post-project, beneficiaries partly self-fund maintenance
Swagruha should only serve rich beneficiaries

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 8 Niwas report explicitly recommends a bank-partnered savings scheme so beneficiaries can partly self-fund future repairs. This is a sustainability-enhancing governance recommendation — not cessation, fee hikes, or elitism. The Trap: Options A, B, D are counter-productive or contradictory to the SE's mission. Cross-Exam Context: Sustainability-via-self-finance logic also in V-B (MF Foundation) and V-A (MF Distributor — SIP-for-savings). Assessor's Pro-Tip: When recommending new partnerships, cite 2-3 named institutional candidates (NHB, HDFC Social, local cooperatives) in the Report. This moves the recommendation from theory to actionable.
